policy_text: Duplicate payments (same customer, same amount, charged within 3 days of each other) are eligible for an automatic refund of the duplicate charge.
Refunds of $100 or less may be issued automatically without human sign-off. Refunds greater than $100 always require human approval before being issued.
Account cancellation requests always require human approval before being processed, regardless of account status.
Customers may update account information (email, name, subscription tier) without approval, subject to identity verification via customer_id.
Purely informational requests that do not change billing or account state (e.g. how-to questions) do not require any human approval.
